## Instructions

1. Preheat the oven to 400ÂºF.
1. In a 12-inch oven-safe skillet, heat the olive oil over medium. When it shimmers, add the Brussels sprouts and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp and lightly caramelized, 3 to 4 minutes. Add the garlic and lemon zest and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds, being sure not to burn them.
1. Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast the Brussels sprouts for about 10 minutes, or until tender.
1. Meanwhile, in a blender or food processor, combine the goatâs milk, goat cheese, mustard, and lemon juice and pulse until smooth. Stir in the red pepper flakes.
1. Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven. Turn the broiler to high. Stir the basil and mint into the Brussels sprouts. Pour the goatâs milk mixture on top. Sprinkle with the Parmesan and almonds. Return to the oven and broil for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the cheese has melted, keeping a close eye on it. Remove and season lightly with flaky sea salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh basil and mint.
